focal_claims_rationale: The four formal hypotheses concern probability shape and deadline moderation (D01 PDF pp. 4 and 7); the article explicitly emphasizes marginal effects over isolated interaction coefficients (D01 PDF p. 11, Results). C1 and C12–C16 record the corresponding empirical summaries and exceptions. Context frequencies, control effects, fit tests, and narrative robustness are separate tiers. Prior-literature assertions and managerial suggestions are not treated as additional fitted empirical claims. Claims are ordered by first statement; later repeats are linked rather than duplicated.
